column1: # Reviewed flag specification for the script-, format- and config-taking programs.
# Every flag a program in this file accepts, switches included, is listed with its
# arity (0 = switch, 1 = takes a value) and its effect. The program table
# (program_table.go) may accept exactly these flags and no others for these
# programs; TestFlagSpecMatchesTable and the property tests read THIS file, not the
# table, so a flag added in code without a reviewed line here fails the build.
# effect: inert (no file, command or network effect), read, output (writes the named
# file), delete, inplace (turns read operands into writes), send (request body),
# upload (reads a local file and sends it), url, exec (runs a program), text:sed |
# text:awk | text:curl_format (the value must pass the closed grammar),
# file:script | file:config (the file's content is code/config we do not read: the
# Deliberately absent (unaccounted): awk -W (takes a value), curl --output-dir (moves
# every -o / -O), curl -o= style long options, any wget log/append flag (-o, -a),
